title: When Dense Optical Flow Stops Reporting the Hand: An Instrument Check for Reading Egocentric Factory Video as Hand Activity Level
description: Build AI publishes that 91.66% of 10,000 sampled frames of its Egocentric-10K factory corpus show the camera wearer actively manipulating an object, as labelled by a vision-language model. A share of time spent working with the hands is a duty cycle, and duty cycle is one of the two inputs to the ACGIH Hand Activity Level (HAL). I pre-registered a measurement of the corpus as HAL before writing code. It has not run, because of cost, and no ergonomist has scored anything. So this note makes no claim about the corpus, about the vendor's figure, or about whether the instrument is accurate. It reports the one check that needs no corpus: whether dense optical flow inside a hand box reports hand speed, tested on rendered scenes under the corpus's published fisheye lens, with a moving camera over a static hand plane, where the true flow is known. Over 20 texture seeds, the ratio of recovered to true flow stays near one up to about 22.8 px of hand motion between the two frames, falls through one half at 29.4 px on a nine-point grid, and settles at 0.19 (sd 0.01), the ratio of the two assumed scene depths (0.18): in this scene, past the crossing the estimator reports the background. RAFT-small crosses later, at 40.4 px over 11 seeds, and lands on the same shelf. At the corpus median speed the pre-registration assumes, and the clip's own frame interval, the hand moves 23 px. That is the edge of the transition, where mean gain is 0.88 (range 0.58 to 0.99) against an error budget of 4.4% of speed. The location of the crossing belongs to this scene and may not transfer: the scene is one geometry with no occlusion, blur or noise, two estimators were tried at their defaults, and the registered pair spacing was changed after this check failed. Three claims in an essay I published earlier from a single seed did not survive the seeds, and are corrected here. Not peer reviewed. Code and data: https://github.com/caiotheodoro/cyclegraph
references: Caio Theodoro. The hand box was measuring the wall. Essay, published 2026-09-08; source in the repository at writing/flow-is-not-hand-speed.md, 2026a.
